title: 4.15 More at Home
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Name eight more parts and things of a home, and say where a key, a cat and a dog are.
grammar_function: It is a/an + home noun; The + noun + is + on/in + the + place.
prerequisite: 1.10 cat, dog; 2.3 table; 2.4 It is a + noun; 4.1 bathroom; 4.3 in, on.
speaking_outcome: Say It is an apartment., The key is on the floor. and The cat is on the roof.
